description: Two players or two teams shown side by side — by default on the metrics that matter for their position, on named metrics when `metrics` is set, and on the full set with all:true. Each side carries its source rank. States both figures and stops: it names no winner, no margin and no recommendation. `metrics` takes verified panel metric keys ("qb_anya.any_a") or their plain-English names. A measure outside the verified panel, such as yards per attempt, is refused with the nearest panel metrics.
name: compare_entities
title: Compare two players or teams
